text: Filecia asks for your help to test the monster she has\ncreated with Lefina. Go to Dycan Lake Swamp to find the\nrequired ingredients!
While testing the monster, Libarza barges in with a monster\nhe has created! His goal appears to be stealing Velcaroy and\ntaking Lefina with him! Defeat Libarza's monster, Mycodian!
[[N]]Collect the ingredients and report to Filecia in El Scaro
[[N]][ff0000]Defeat Mycodian at the Ancient Exhibition Grounds[ffffff]
